name: spring-boot-library
title: Kütüphane Plus – Library Lending System
description: A Spring Boot 3 library lending system with a public catalogue, member borrowing/returns and a librarian admin area, using Spring Security form login with server-side sessions and CSRF, Thymeleaf views and a file-based H2 database.

env.name: DB_PATH
env.description: H2 database file prefix without extension; H2 creates <DB_PATH>.mv.db (Docker image sets /app/data/library)

env.name: SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE
env.description: Set to 'prod' to hide stack traces/messages in error pages (Docker image sets prod). H2 console is disabled in every profile.

auth.description: Spring Security form login (POST /login with username/password/_csrf) backed by a BCrypt UserDetailsService over the members table; JSESSIONID cookie session, CSRF token required on every POST, roles ROLE_ADMIN and ROLE_MEMBER enforced by requestMatchers (/admin/** hasRole ADMIN, /my/** and /loans/** authenticated). 403 renders a custom page.

persistence: H2 file database at ./data/library.mv.db (DB_PATH; /app/data inside the container) – schema managed by Hibernate ddl-auto=update, seeded with 10 books, 2 users and 3 loans when the members table is empty
notes: Java/Maven are not required on the host when using Docker (multi-stage build compiles inside maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-21). Without Docker, JDK 21 is required and ./mvnw downloads Maven 3.9.16 on first use (needs network). First Maven build downloads ~120 MB of dependencies. Container runs as non-root user 'app'; mount a writable volume at /app/data. Startup takes ~8-20 s before /actuator/health returns 200, so give the healthcheck a start period.
